    Indecomposable projectives of a directed algebra #

    A = ⊕_{z ∈ T} A e_z (decompSelf), and free modules decompose into copies of the P(z) (decompFree). Hence a nonzero indecomposable summand of a free module is isomorphic to some P(z) (iso_proj_of_freeSummand).
